name: substack-reader-pp-mcp
description: Read any Substack publication as a local, full-text-searchable corpus — keyless for free posts, your own session for what you subscribe to.

substack_session.title: SUBSTACK_SESSION (optional)
substack_session.description: Optional. Your own Substack session cookie (substack.sid) to unlock paid posts you already subscribe to. Leave blank to run anonymously — free and public posts need no credential.
